refnamediv.refpurpose: Estimate transfer function of system with input "x" and output "y".

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Estimate transfer function of system with input "x" and output "y". Use the Welch (1967) periodogram/FFT method. Compatible with Matlab R11 tfe and earlier. See "help pwelch" for description of arguments, hints and references — especially hint (7) for Matlab R11 defaults.
